snippet.title: Toy Escape // Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3654580/Toy_Escape/

Toy Escape is a co-op game for up to 4 players where you play as a small toy trying to climb your way through a giant house to reach the rooftop and escape. Jump, climb, and find your way out in this fun, toy-sized adventure!

Developed by
Samuel De Pablo, David Gallardo
